name: kiwi cat
behavior: Floats toward the nearest player at 5.6 u/s (pursuit ceiling 0.80 - never above 7.2 u/s after multipliers); contact kills. Meows every 3 s while within 14 u.
counter_play: Open ground - walk away. Thin path or dead end - hurdle it as it arrives: a jump exceeds its 1.5 u reach from 0.16 s to 0.59 s of the jump.
tell: Meows every 3 s while within 14 u - a slow clock that never stops.
